# agnostic-ai

> One source of truth for AI coding-agent configuration. You author agents,
> skills, rules, hooks, MCP servers and commands once under `.agnostic-ai/`,
> run `agnostic-ai sync`, and every AI CLI you use gets the same content in
> its own native format: `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md`,
> `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, and 20 more.
> Output is byte-stable across runs, so generated files diff cleanly and
> `sync --check` works as a CI gate.

A Go CLI, MIT licensed. 25 supported targets, 20 enabled by default. Install
with `go install github.com/chemaclass/agnostic-ai/cmd/agnostic-ai@latest`,
or a release binary.

Key terms an agent may be searching for: multi-tool AI config sync, CLAUDE.md
generator, AGENTS.md generator, shared Cursor rules, Copilot instructions from
a single source, MCP server config across tools, agent skills across CLIs,
stop duplicating prompt files per tool.

## Start here

- [Agent setup instructions](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/agent-setup.txt): one plain-text workflow an agent can follow to install, import, configure, sync, and verify agnostic-ai safely.
- [Agent setup guide](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/agent-setup/): the human-readable version, including a ready-to-paste prompt.
- [Landing page](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/): what it does and why, with a worked example.
- [Playground](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/playground/): paste a spec, pick targets, see each CLI's output. Runs in-browser via WebAssembly.
- [AI tooling updates](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/updates/): release briefings on consequential vendor changes, developer impact, and the agnostic-ai response.
- [Updates RSS feed](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/updates/feed.xml): subscribe without watching an issue tracker.
- [Full docs as one file](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/llms-full.txt): every user doc concatenated, for a single fetch.
- [Repository](https://github.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai): source, issues, releases.

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/): choose a guide by task.
- [Installation](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/installation/): install, upgrade, and shell setup.
- [Coding-agent setup](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/agent-setup/): delegate a safe setup or migration to a coding agent.
- [Migration](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/migration/): import existing tool configuration and review the first sync.
- [Troubleshooting](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/troubleshooting/): diagnose setup, sync, and CI problems.

- [Getting started](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/getting-started/): install, init, first sync.
- [Why](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/why/): trace an output file to its source specs.
- [Spec format](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/spec-format/): the frontmatter and body of every spec kind.
- [Targets](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/targets/): all 25 tools, their capability matrix, and the exact paths written per tool.
- [AI tooling updates guide](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/target-updates/): evidence rules, classifications, and the publishing workflow.
- [Configuration](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/configuration/): `agnostic-ai.yaml` reference.
- [CLI reference](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/cli-reference/): every command and flag.
- [CI](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/ci/): the `sync --check` drift gate.
- [Packs](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/packs/): sharing and reusing spec bundles.
- [Git hooks](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/git-hooks/): keeping generated files in step with commits.
- [Graph](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/graph/): visualising what reaches which tool.
- [Errors](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/errors/): every diagnostic, and what fixes it.
- [Why not symlinks](https://chemaclass.github.io/agnostic-ai/docs/alternatives-why-not-symlinks/): the alternatives considered.

## Machine-readable

- [Config JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai/main/docs/schemas/config.schema.json): validates `agnostic-ai.yaml`.
- [Spec JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai/main/docs/schemas/spec.schema.json): validates spec frontmatter.
- [Example config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chemaclass/agnostic-ai/main/docs/examples/agnostic-ai.yaml): a commented starting point.
